output.reason: [ev-793c99a321e0] lists `cilium_identity_label_sources` under "Added Metrics" and calls it a new metric that counts identities per label source. It is not an HTTP/gRPC endpoint, so the api-endpoint family is wrong, and that family's name would have to take the form "METHOD /path". The proposed subject also puts the product in a field, which the rules forbid. No subject family in the vocabulary fits a Prometheus metric, so no corrected assertion can be built. That is why this is a rejection, not a correction.
